<thought>To obtain the precursors, I first need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the DIBAL‑H reduction of an ester to an aldehyde. This template should break an “ester” functional group and form an “aldehyde”. I will search the template catalog for such a template using one of the provided product SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aldehyde"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
